intro: Current officers. Role descriptions are the duties in the club constitution.
source: Seated roles: https://www.stuorg.iastate.edu/swcc/officers read 2026-09-24. Candidate files, where they exist, are in Elections/2026-03-26/ and are applications, not a results list. Duties: Constitution/2025 SWCC Constitution.docx Article 6. Photos on disk: assets/headshots/BhuwanShah.jpg and RyanMcGehee.jpeg.

people.name: Muntaha Ateeq
people.description: Conducts meetings, organizes club events, and leads outreach.
people.source: Student Organizations officers page, 2026-09-24. Application: Elections/2026-03-26/Multiple - Muntaha Ateeq -2026 Office.pdf.

people.name: Bhuwan Shah
people.description: Assists the president, runs officer elections, and is the risk management officer.
people.source: Student Organizations officers page, 2026-09-24, and Wiki/Entities/Programs/SWCC.md. Application: Elections/2026-03-26/Multiple - Bhuwan Shah.pdf.

people.name: William Vlasek
people.description: Keeps the club accounts, files university paperwork, and reports the budget.
people.source: Student Organizations officers page, 2026-09-24. No matching file in Elections/2026-03-26/.

people.name: Pooja Timilsina
people.description: Records meeting minutes and handles logistics for projects such as the annual publication.
people.source: Student Organizations officers page, 2026-09-24. Application: Elections/2026-03-26/Multiple - Pooja Timilsina.pdf.

people.name: Asmita Shrestha
people.description: Keeps the website and social media current and coordinates outreach.
people.source: Student Organizations officers page, 2026-09-24. Application: Elections/2026-03-26/Communications Officer-Asmita Shrestha.pdf. Duty: Constitution Article 6.

people.name: Revanth Mamidala
people.description: Represents the club at CALS Council and reports college business back to the club.
people.source: Student Organizations officers page, 2026-09-24. Duty title: Constitution Article 6, CALS Student Council Representative.

people.name: Courtney Strauser
people.description: Handles club business with the university.
people.source: Student Organizations officers page, 2026-09-24. The constitution does not define this office.

people.name: Richard Cruse
people.description: Advises the club and is a liaison with the university.
people.source: Student Organizations officers page, 2026-09-24. Advisor duties: Constitution Article 7.

people.name: Ryan McGehee
people.description: Advises the club. Groundwater-model orders are addressed to this office.
people.source: Student Organizations officers page, 2026-09-24. Email and attn line: Forms/SWCC_GroundwaterModel_OrderForm_2026.pdf.
